description: Scaffold apps/api as a NestJS 11 modular monolith that builds and tests out of the box, mirror the @lhd/shared contract into the app, and stand up the persistence abstraction (repository interfaces + in-memory implementations + a Prisma schema selected only when DATABASE_URL is set). This is the foundation every later feature builds on; it is a prerequisite for FEAT-002/003/004.
steps: Create apps/api/package.json with name "@lhd/api", private true. Dependencies: @nestjs/common, @nestjs/core, @nestjs/platform-express, @nestjs/config, @nestjs/jwt, @nestjs/passport, passport, passport-jwt, bcrypt, reflect-metadata, rxjs, @prisma/client. DevDependencies: @nestjs/cli, @nestjs/testing, @nestjs/schematics, typescript, ts-jest, jest, @types/jest, @types/node, @types/bcrypt, @types/passport-jwt, @types/supertest, supertest, source-map-support, prisma, ts-loader. Use NestJS ^11. Scripts: "build": "nest build", "start": "node dist/main.js", "start:dev": "nest start --watch", "test": "jest", "test:e2e": "jest --config jest-e2e.config.js". Pin dependency versions (exact or ^ minor-pinned), prefer well-known official packages.

Create apps/api/tsconfig.json (module commonjs, target ES2021, experimentalDecorators true, emitDecoratorMetadata true, esModuleInterop true, resolveJsonModule true, outDir ./dist, baseUrl ./, strict true) and apps/api/tsconfig.build.json (extends tsconfig, excludes node_modules, dist, **/*.spec.ts, **/*.e2e-spec.ts, test). Create apps/api/nest-cli.json ({ "collection": "@nestjs/schematics", "sourceRoot": "src" }).

Create apps/api/jest.config.js (preset-free ts-jest config: testEnvironment node, rootDir src, testRegex ".spec.ts$", transform ts-jest, moduleFileExtensions ts/js/json) and apps/api/jest-e2e.config.js (rootDir ., testRegex ".e2e-spec.ts$", ts-jest transform).

Create apps/api/src/config/env.ts exporting a typed accessor for DATABASE_URL (optional), JWT_SECRET (default dev secret), and LHD_CONTENT_ROOT (optional override). Create apps/api/src/main.ts bootstrapping NestFactory, app.setGlobalPrefix('api'), ValidationPipe, listen on PORT (default 3001). Create apps/api/src/app.module.ts importing ConfigModule.forRoot({ isGlobal: true }) and (for now) PersistenceModule; later features add ContentModule, AuthModule, UsersModule, ProgressModule, AiModule.

Mirror the shared contract: create apps/api/src/shared/contract.ts by copying every type/interface from packages/shared/src/index.ts VERBATIM (DevelopmentDomainKey, Audience, AgeRange, DevelopmentDomain, YearPlan, Activity, GuidanceItem, Milestone, Project, AppFeature, Source, Phase, CatalogEntry, Catalog, UserRole, ProgressRecord). Add a header comment: 'Mirrored from packages/shared/src/index.ts (the single source of truth). Keep in sync; do not diverge.' Add apps/api/src/shared/contract.conformance.spec.ts with sample object literals typed as Phase, Catalog, CatalogEntry, ProgressRecord and a UserRole union check, asserting they compile and a trivial runtime expect passes.

Create the persistence layer: apps/api/src/persistence/repositories.ts defining interfaces UserRepository, CaregiverLinkRepository, ProgressRepository and InjectionToken constants (USER_REPOSITORY, CAREGIVER_LINK_REPOSITORY, PROGRESS_REPOSITORY), plus entity shapes (User with id, email, passwordHash, role: UserRole, isMinor, displayName; CaregiverLink with caregiverId, learnerId; reuse ProgressRecord from contract). Add apps/api/src/persistence/in-memory/*.ts implementing all three with Maps. Add apps/api/src/persistence/prisma/prisma.service.ts and prisma-*.repository.ts implementations. Create apps/api/src/persistence/persistence.module.ts that provides the in-memory impls by default and the Prisma impls only when env DATABASE_URL is set (useFactory switching on the config), exporting the three tokens.

Create apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma with datasource postgresql (url env DATABASE_URL), generator client, and models User (id, email unique, passwordHash, role enum, isMinor, displayName, createdAt), CaregiverLink (id, caregiverId, learnerId, unique [caregiverId, learnerId]), ProgressRecord (id, userId, phaseId, itemKey, status enum, updatedAt, unique [userId, phaseId, itemKey]), plus enums for Role and ProgressStatus. Do NOT wire prisma generate into build or test.

Create apps/api/.env.example documenting PORT, DATABASE_URL (optional — unset uses in-memory), JWT_SECRET, LHD_CONTENT_ROOT (optional). Add a .gitignore under apps/api for dist and node_modules if needed.

Wire root scripts additively in the repo-root package.json: ADD "test:api": "npm --workspace @lhd/api test" and ensure a "dev" script can start the api (e.g. "dev:api": "npm --workspace @lhd/api run start:dev"; if a "dev" script is added it must run web+api, but do not break or remove the existing "test" and "content:validate" scripts). Run `npm install` at repo root so the new workspace links.
Create a trivial placeholder spec if no other spec exists yet so `npm test` exits 0 (the conformance spec from step 5 satisfies this).
acceptance_criteria: From apps/api, `npm run build` compiles with zero TypeScript errors (empty-but-wired app).
From apps/api, `npm test` runs Jest and passes (contract.conformance.spec passes).
apps/api/src/shared/contract.ts contains the mirrored types with a header naming packages/shared/src/index.ts as the source of truth.
PersistenceModule provides in-memory repositories when DATABASE_URL is unset; no running database is required for build or test.
Root package.json still contains the original "test" (content:validate) and "content:validate" scripts unchanged, plus an added api test script.
From repo root, `npm run content:validate` still passes.
verification: cd apps/api; npm run build  (expect exit 0, no TS errors)
cd apps/api; npm test  (expect Jest green)
From repo root: npm run content:validate  (expect still green)
findings:
SCAFFOLD COMPLETE. Verified: `npm run build` (nest build) exits 0; `npm test` green (8 tests, 2 suites); root `npm run content:validate` still green (13 phases).

DEPENDENCY VERSIONS CHOSEN (apps/api/package.json, caret-pinned to minor): @nestjs/common ^11.2.8, @nestjs/core ^11.2.8, @nestjs/platform-express ^11.2.8, @nestjs/config ^4.0.4, @nestjs/jwt ^11.0.2, @nestjs/passport ^11.0.5, passport ^0.7.0, passport-jwt ^4.0.1, bcrypt ^6.0.0, reflect-metadata ^0.2.2, rxjs ^7.8.2, @prisma/client ^6.19.3 (Prisma 6 stable; v7/v8 avoided), class-validator ^0.15.1, class-transformer ^0.5.1. Dev: @nestjs/cli ^11.0.24, @nestjs/schematics ^11.1.0, @nestjs/testing ^11.2.8, typescript ^5.9.3, jest ^29.7.0, ts-jest ^29.4.15 (jest 29 line to match ts-jest 29), @types/jest ^29.5.14, @types/node ^24.9.2, @types/bcrypt ^6.0.0, @types/passport-jwt ^4.0.1, @types/supertest ^7.2.1, supertest ^7.3.1, source-map-support ^0.5.21, prisma ^6.19.3, ts-loader ^9.6.2. ADDED beyond task list (needed to make scaffold compile/boot): passport, class-validator, class-transformer. Jest pinned to 29 (NOT 30) so ts-jest 29.x is compatible.

ENV VARS (src/config/env.ts): PORT (default 3001, getPort()), DATABASE_URL (optional; getDatabaseUrl()/hasDatabaseUrl() — UNSET selects in-memory repos), JWT_SECRET (getJwtSecret(), dev default export DEV_JWT_SECRET='lhd-dev-insecure-secret-change-me'), LHD_CONTENT_ROOT (optional override, getContentRootOverride()).

CONTRACT: src/shared/contract.ts mirrors packages/shared/src/index.ts VERBATIM with source-of-truth header. Drift guard: src/shared/contract.conformance.spec.ts. Import types from '../shared/contract' (relative), NOT from @lhd/shared (raw-ESM, not buildable under CommonJS).

PERSISTENCE (src/persistence/): repositories.ts exports entity shapes {User (id,email,passwordHash,role:UserRole,isMinor,displayName), NewUser=Omit<User,'id'>, CaregiverLink (caregiverId,learnerId)} and reuses ProgressRecord from contract. Interfaces + method signatures:
- UserRepository: create(user:NewUser):Promise<User>; findById(id):Promise<User|null>; findByEmail(email):Promise<User|null> (case-insensitive in in-memory); list():Promise<User[]>; delete(id):Promise<boolean>.
- CaregiverLinkRepository: link(link:CaregiverLink):Promise<CaregiverLink>; unlink(caregiverId,learnerId):Promise<boolean>; exists(caregiverId,learnerId):Promise<boolean>; listForCaregiver(caregiverId):Promise<CaregiverLink[]>; listForLearner(learnerId):Promise<CaregiverLink[]>.
- ProgressRepository: upsert(record:ProgressRecord):Promise<ProgressRecord>; findForUser(userId):Promise<ProgressRecord[]>; findOne(userId,phaseId,itemKey):Promise<ProgressRecord|null>; deleteForUser(userId):Promise<number>.
DI TOKEN CONSTANTS (string tokens): USER_REPOSITORY='USER_REPOSITORY', CAREGIVER_LINK_REPOSITORY='CAREGIVER_LINK_REPOSITORY', PROGRESS_REPOSITORY='PROGRESS_REPOSITORY'. Inject with @Inject(USER_REPOSITORY) etc.
PersistenceModule is @Global() and EXPORTS the three tokens; provides InMemory* by default, Prisma* only when hasDatabaseUrl(). Prisma impls depend on PrismaService (src/persistence/prisma/prisma.service.ts) which loads @prisma/client via guarded dynamic require() so tsc/tests need NO generated client. PrismaService exposes `.db` (PrismaClientLike with user/caregiverLink/progressRecord delegates).

PRISMA SCHEMA (apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma): provider postgresql, models User/CaregiverLink/ProgressRecord, enums Role {learner,parent,guardian,educator,admin} and ProgressStatus {not_started,in_progress,completed}. NOTE enum values use underscores (Prisma enum identifiers can't contain hyphens) — the contract's ProgressRecord.status uses hyphens ('not-started'|'in-progress'); FEAT that wires Prisma persistence must map between them. `prisma generate` is NOT wired into build/test.

MAIN: src/main.ts sets app.setGlobalPrefix('api') and a global ValidationPipe (whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted, transform). app.module.ts imports ConfigModule.forRoot({isGlobal:true}) + PersistenceModule; later features register ContentModule/AuthModule/UsersModule/ProgressModule/AiModule here.

ROOT package.json: added scripts test:api ('npm --workspace @lhd/api test') and dev:api; existing 'test' (content:validate) and 'content:validate' left UNCHANGED. Root tsconfig NOT modified (not needed). apps/api/.gitignore ignores dist/, node_modules/, coverage/, .env.
